hint: The order of operations says which part to work out first. Look for grouping symbols before anything else.

hints.text: The order of operations says which part to work out first. Look for grouping symbols before anything else.
Do the parentheses first: $8 + 4 = 12$. The expression becomes $3 \times 12 - 6$, and multiplication comes before subtraction.

explanation: Work inside the parentheses first, because grouping symbols come before everything else: $8 + 4 = 12$.
Multiply next, since multiplication comes before subtraction: $3 \times 12 = 36$.
Subtract last: $36 - 6 = 30$, so the value of the expression is $30$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Why parentheses matter
steps: Parentheses say: do this part first.
